name: ancient gold dragon
desc: Ancient Gold Dragon is a CR 24 dragon.

actions.name: amphibious
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can breathe air and water.

actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes {count} [[/item]] attacks and uses [[/item]].

actions.name: fire breath
actions.desc: Dexterity Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]], each [[lookup @target.affects.type activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]]-foot-long, [[lookup @target.template.width activity=bDqgmtLG3zcVuqdi]]-foot-wide Line. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage. Success: Half damage.

actions.name: spellcasting
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} casts one of the following spells, requiring no Material components and using Charisma as the spellcasting ability (spell save DC [[lookup @attributes.spell.dc]]): At Will: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplDetectMagi]{Detect Magic}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{Guiding Bolt} (level 4 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplShapechang]{Shapechange} (Beast or Humanoid form only, no Temporary Hit Points gained from the spell, and no Concentration or Temporary Hit Points required to maintain the spell) 1/Day Each: @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplFlameStrik]{Flame Strike} (level 6 version), @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplWordofReca]{Word of Recall}, @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplZoneofTrut]{Zone of Truth}

actions.name: weakening breath
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=EGZ4bS4HpJkfNG9s]], each creature that isn't currently affected by this breath in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=EGZ4bS4HpJkfNG9s]]-foot Cone. Failure: The target has Disadvantage on Strength-based D20 Tests and subtracts 5 ([[/r 1d10]]) from its damage rolls. It repeats the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. After [[lookup @duration.value activity=EGZ4bS4HpJkfNG9s]] minute, it succeeds automatically.

actions.name: banish
actions.desc: Charisma Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=kWKwiAYgyeKBLMNJ]], one creature the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can see within [[lookup @range.value activity=kWKwiAYgyeKBLMNJ]] feet. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Incapacitated apply=false] condition and is transported to a harmless demiplane until the start of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s next turn, at which point it re­appears in an unoccupied space of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s choice within [[lookup @range.value activity=kWKwiAYgyeKBLMNJ]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}. Failure or Success: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again [[lookup @duration.special activity=kWKwiAYgyeKBLMNJ]].

actions.name: guiding light
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} uses Spellcasting to cast @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplGuidingBol]{Guiding Bolt} (level 2 version).

actions.name: pounce
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item Rend]] attack.
